notes.title: #TurnBasedFest & a new OPEN pre-alpha for you to try out!
notes.content:
A cobbled-up small preview of some of the new stuff - 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DSiANmfm118

The progress we've managed to do in the 4 months of open development is something we're quite proud of, starting from a small idea of making a no-RNG roguelite tactical to now preparing to develop a complete narrative experience - the demo Introductory Arc also being a test of some under-the-hood stuff such as stats-accounting in the interactions with the gods. 

The link's in the description. 

Don't be afraid to try it out! We're constantly updating the pre-alpha demo as development races along!

Last but not least, 

[h3]Big shout-out to the people behind #TurnBasedFest![/h3] They've been amazingly helpful and supportive and we're really happy for all the love that developers of these intricate games based on 1 mechanic get!
